confirm.title: Import energy statistics again
confirm.description:
Import of energy statistics for **{pod_name}** on **{day}** was paused because the portal returned invalid data ({reason}). Later days were not imported so the running total cannot skip a hole.

1. Check that the SSD IMS portal shows complete data for that day.
2. Confirm below (or call the `ssd_ims.reimport_statistics` action) to rewrite that day through yesterday.
3. When the portal returns a valid day, the import continues and this warning clears. A later scheduled poll also retries without any action from you.

reimport_statistics.name: Reimport statistics
reimport_statistics.description: Re-fetch portal data from the chosen local day through yesterday and rewrite hourly statistics so running totals stay continuous. Defaults to the paused day, or yesterday. Scheduled polls do not rewrite closed days.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which SSD IMS entry to reimport. Leave empty to reimport all loaded entries.

date.name: Day
date.description: Local calendar day to start rewriting from (YYYY-MM-DD). That day and all later days through yesterday are rewritten. Defaults to the paused day or yesterday.

init.title: SSD IMS Options
init.description: Update integration settings. Optional VT/NT prices are final prices in EUR per kWh incl. VAT, as printed on your supplier invoice (SSE: "Aktuálne koncové ceny elektriny platné pre Vašu sadzbu"). They are used to import hourly costs for the actual consumption statistic and monthly costs for the tariff register readings. For a single-rate tariff (D1/D2) fill in VT only; leave both empty to skip costs. If the SSE eZóna integration (sse_ezona) is installed, its prices are used instead for points with the same EIC code.

data_description.price_vt: Final price in EUR per kWh including VAT and all per-kWh fees, e.g. from your supplier invoice.
data_description.price_nt: Final price in EUR per kWh including VAT and all per-kWh fees, e.g. from your supplier invoice. Leave empty for single-rate tariffs (D1/D2) — the VT price is then used for all consumption.
